headline: Customers Struggle to Pay Installments, Non-Performing Loans of 5 Leasing Companies Reach 5%
summary: The OJK financial regulator reported five finance companies with NPF ratios above 5% as of September 2026. Industry net profit still grew 22.80% year on year despite the challenges.
why: Non-performing financing ratios show credit quality at leasing companies, which lend to consumers and businesses and are closely watched for systemic credit risk.
original_headline: Nasabah Kesulitan Bayar Cicilan, Kredit Macet 5 Leasing Tembus 5%
